title: [review] lib.rs: Test assertion off-by-one after spec com
description: After commit 398dee5eba changed the formula from `n_channels.max(3) - 1` to `n_channels.max(3)`, valid channels now include n_channels itself (range [1, n_channels]). The assertion `ch < 16` should be `ch <= 16`. Same issue at lines 279, 287, 288, 344, 373, 374, 390, 391. These tests would incorrectly fail if the hash produces the maximum channel value.
